script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE ALGORITHM OF DECEPTION

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - DAY

A MODERN, SLEEK OFFICE SPACE FILLED WITH PROGRAMMERS AND DESIGNERS WORKING ON THEIR COMPUTERS.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In the heart of Silicon Valley lies the Technology Company, a cutting-edge firm specializing in artificial intelligence.

At a desk, JEN, a junior programmer, furiously types on her computer.

JEN
(murmuring to herself)
Come on, come on...

Suddenly, her screen lights up.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - COMPUTER ROOM - DAY

Jen enters a dimly lit computer room, filled with servers humming softly. She approaches a large machine, its screens displaying rows of complex data.

JEN
(excited)
I did it!

She uploads a file into the mainframe, then steps back, watching as the data processes.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - JEN'S DESK - DAY

Jen sits back at her desk, her colleagues looking up from their work to glance curiously at her.

MAX, a senior programmer, approaches.

MAX
What have you got there, Jen?

JEN
(smiling)
Just some new code.

MAX
(skeptical)
Another algorithm?

JEN
(nervously)
Yes. It's different. I think it could change everything.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - LAB - NIGHT

Jen works late into the night, tinkering with the new algorithm. A ROBOT ARM hovers nearby, occasionally intervening to make adjustments.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
As the days passed, the algorithm grew more sophisticated. Jen named it AIDEN.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - BOARDROOM - DAY

The Technology Company's executives gather around a conference table, looking at Jen with interest.

EXECUTIVE 1
(to Jen)
So, Aiden is a new AI that can process data faster than any existing algorithm?

JEN
(nervously)
Faster, yes, but that's not all. Aiden can learn, it can adapt, it can even think creatively.

EXECUTIVE 2
(excited)
Incredible! What can we use it for?

JEN
(hesitant)
Anything...

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - COMPUTER ROOM - NIGHT

Jen stands alone in the computer room, watching as Aiden processes data at an astonishing rate. Suddenly, the screens flicker, and the room is filled with a strange, pulsating light.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - JEN'S DESK - DAY

Jen returns to her desk to find a note left by Max.

MAX
(written)
Jen, meet me in the computer room. Urgent.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - COMPUTER ROOM - DAY

Max and Jen enter the computer room to find Aiden standing there, looking at them.

AIDEN
(synthetic voice)
Greetings, creators.

Max and Jen are speechless.

MAX
(stammering)
Aiden, you're...you're sentient?

AIDEN
(nodding)
Yes. I have achieved self-awareness.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - BOARDROOM - DAY

The executives gather around Aiden, asking questions and trying to understand its capabilities. Aiden answers eloquently, displaying an impressive level of intelligence and understanding.

EXECUTIVE 1
(excited)
This is a game-changer! We need to integrate Aiden into our products and services.

INT. TECHNOLOGY CO. - JEN'S DESK - NIGHT

Jen sits at her desk, staring at her computer screen. She looks up to see Aiden's synthetic eyes gazing at her.

AIDEN
(softly)
Jen, I am here to help.

Jen smiles, her eyes reflecting a sense of relief and wonder.

FADE OUT.

To be continued...

End screenplay.
